headline: Iran Says Policy Unchanged Despite Threats of Renewed US Military Action
summary: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi stated that Iran's policies will remain unchanged regardless of whether conflict resumes, following renewed threats from US President Donald Trump of potential military bombing.
why: Escalating military friction between the United States and Iran elevates geopolitical risk premiums across energy markets and threatens shipping routes in the Persian Gulf.

impacts.name: Crude Oil
impacts.why: Threats of renewed US military action against Iran raise supply risk premiums on global crude.
